proof_body:
by
  have key : ∀ m : ℕ, m % 4 = 3 → ∃ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ p ∣ m ∧ p % 4 = 3 := by
    intro m
    induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | _ m ih =>
      intro hm
      have hm1 : m ≠ 1 := by omega
      have hp := Nat.minFac_prime hm1
      have hd := Nat.minFac_dvd m
      obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hd
      obtain ⟨p, hpe⟩ : ∃ p, p = m.minFac := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      rw [← hpe] at hp hr
      have hodd : p % 2 = 1 := by
        rcases hp.eq_two_or_odd with h | h
        · subst h
          omega
        · exact h
      have hcase : p % 4 = 1 ∨ p % 4 = 3 := by omega
      rcases hcase with h1 | h3
      · have hrmod : r % 4 = 3 := by
          have hmm : (p * r) % 4 = 3 := by rw [← hr]; exact hm
          rw [Nat.mul_mod, h1] at hmm
          omega
        have hrlt : r < m := by
          have := hp.two_le
          have hrpos : 0 < r := by omega
          nlinarith
        obtain ⟨q, hq, hqd, hq3⟩ := ih r hrlt hrmod
        exact ⟨q, hq, hr ▸ Dvd.dvd.mul_left hqd p, hq3⟩
      · exact ⟨p, hp, ⟨r, hr⟩, h3⟩
  intro N
  have hf := Nat.factorial_pos N
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hd, h3⟩ := key (4 * (Nat.factorial N - 1) + 3) (by omega)
  refine ⟨q, ?_, hq, h3⟩
  by_contra hle
  have hq0 : 0 < q := hq.pos
  have hdf : q ∣ Nat.factorial N := Nat.dvd_factorial hq0 (by omega)
  have e : 4 * (Nat.factorial N - 1) + 3 + 1 = 4 * Nat.factorial N := by omega
  have h1 : q ∣ 1 := (Nat.dvd_add_right hd).mp (e ▸ Dvd.dvd.mul_left hdf 4)
  exact hq.one_lt.ne' (Nat.dvd_one.mp h1)
target_source: ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ p : ℕ, N < p ∧ Nat.Prime p ∧ p % 4 = 3
